title: A/R Summary and A/R Detail show the same Totals for the same filters
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The organization has open documents in these reports at two locations, {Location-A} and {Location-B}, and you are enrolled at both; {Location-A}'s name comes first in A to Z order.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 and {Location-B} is Staging Lethbridge - 4310.
  • The organization has open invoices, credit memos and deposits on today's date at both locations.
  • Starting screen: Reports (top menu; its left menu lists the A/R reports under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE and the A/P reports under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE) in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open A/R Summary.
  2. In the Location menu, untick {Location-B}.
  3. Read the Totals row's Total.
  4. Open A/R Detail.
  5. In the Location menu, untick {Location-B}.
  6. Read the Totals row's Open balance.
  7. Compare the two.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: A/R Summary opens.
  • Step 2: the report narrows to {Location-A}.
  • Step 3: note the amount.
  • Step 4: A/R Detail opens.
  • Step 5: the report narrows to {Location-A}.
  • Step 6: note the amount.
  • Step 7: the two amounts are equal, to the cent.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location)

  • S5-R18: “The Totals row always adds up exactly the rows the filters leave (customer or vendor, Past due, Location), on screen on every page, in the PDF and in the CSV. On A/R Collection and A/P Unpaid Invoices this fixes today's Totals row, which ignores the customer or vendor filter.”
  • What changes for existing users: “Which rows and amounts each user can see is unchanged: an untouched report shows exactly today's organization-wide numbers (apart from the Totals rows noted above), and the reports show money exactly as they do today.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), read 22 Oct 2026: page 7 "Filters and call list" (board Filters.dc.html). Compare the screen with the pictures below at 100% zoom; the expected results still come from the PRD quotes above, the pictures give the look and the on-screen labels.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ar-ap-p7-past-due-ticked.png: figure "Past due ticked" (New in this build), board "7. Filters and call list"
  • ar-ap-p7-call-list-on-a-r-collection.png: figure "Call list on A/R Collection" (New in this build), board "7. Filters and call list"

The design's own words:

  • "31-60 days and 91+ days ticked: the chip reads "Past due: 2 ranges" in blue. The Summary lists only customers with an amount in those ranges, at full balances; the Totals row adds up exactly these rows. S5-R15, S5-R16, S5-R17, S5-R18, S5-R19." (caption of "Past due ticked")
  • "Customer picked: the group row shows "Phone:" and, for users with View and Manage AP/AR Data, "Credit term:". The Totals row follows the customer filter. S9-R1, S9-R2, S5-R18. Exports carry the same lines and columns: S9-R3, S3-R5, S3-R8a." (caption of "Call list on A/R Collection")
